allocations.design: Ten independent families × one model × two real Broker versions; four own-version journeys fixed as a subset, no extra eight runs and no winner selection on confirmation data.
Six anchors × free/off × two environments; all four cells are new. No reuse of earlier free results as predeclared Code Mode data.
Five exact additional anchor variants × two environments.
Two semantic journeys × clean/fault × two actually supported environments; common capability requires equivalent independently observed fault.

own_version_confirmation.candidate_provenance_limit: Later candidate acceptance is supported by fresh named issue/comment snapshots and declared package/runtime bridge; Pro original receipt was not directly read on Mini. Both source tuples require fresh Mini common-apparatus zero-send captures.

stable_public_anchor.scope: published GitHub non-prerelease pair, not a claim of present Benchmark compatibility
stable_public_anchor.compatibility_limit: Published CLI v0.3.0 lacks ./sdk and dist/sdk.js required by current paired builder. Do not inject a newer SDK and label it the unchanged released pair. A separate legitimate compatible plan must fit the remaining5; otherwise retain unavailable/unmeasured with no invented score.

All cases, weights, model, candidate/reference and policies frozen before confirmation opening; history exposure, seal/open and subject visibility separately verified.
